rules.title: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting (S.2983)
rules.requirement: Proposed bill to prohibit algorithmic rent setting in Massachusetts. It is a new draft of S.994 and S.1016, the latter titled the 'Preventing Algorithmic Rent Fixing in the Rental Housing Market Act'. The Joint Committee on Housing reported it favorably on 3/12/2026 and referred it to Senate Ways and Means. It has not been enacted. This page does not give the bill's substantive provisions.
